findings.text: follow-on: the new age-based sweep removes unattributed scratch that the pre-existing --scratch survey documents as "never removed" and "never by age" (routing.py:1946), so crew gc and crew gc --scratch now give opposite dispositions for one directory and an operator reading either docstring alone is misled.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against e49e4731; ten files, all inside the declared scope, effectively additive with the single deletion an import line reconciled into a tuple import.
item_verdicts.done_when: the FENCE-EVIDENCE names four deliverables and a test gate judged by delta; the manifest records base 141 passed/2 skipped and head 147 passed/2 skipped at EXIT=0 with both logs on disk, matching the gate the prompt names.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is "gc sweeps orphaned run scratch and dispatch refuses without /tmp headroom"; reckon/crew/routing.py:1863 adds garbage_collect_orphan_scratch and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8262 adds require_worker_scratch_headroom, so both halves are present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate result, names base-gate.log and head-gate-committed.log, and reports the report-only survey.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path the diff touches is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_gc_sweeps_orphan_scratch.py:68 asserts the live-pointer withholding, and the negative control at exit 1 shows it reddens when the check is removed; tests/test_dispatch_refuses_without_tmp_headroom.py:38 asserts the refusal.
justifications.evidence: the two gate logs on disk read base 141 passed/2 skipped and head 147 passed/2 skipped at EXIT=0, and gc-report.json reconciles with the fragment's 26,210 eligible / 1,399,565,352 bytes / 0 removed.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:1863 and the pre-existing garbage_collect_scratch at :1997 both survey the same root with opposite disposition policies, and _scratch_process_holders at :1845 re-derives the /proc cwd and fd scan already written in _processes_holding at :1969.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:1863 sweeps aged unclaimed scratch and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8262 refuses below the configured floor, matching both halves of the goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff e49e4731..ce20c5d touches exactly the declared write paths with 463 insertions against 1 deletion.
